user_story: As a user, I want to update the description of a task so that I can add more context.

positive.title: Successfully update task description
steps: Open the task in the task management application.
Click the 'Edit' button for the task description.
Enter a new valid description in the input field.
positive.expected_result: The task description is updated with the new text and confirmation message 'Description updated successfully' is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to update the task description with an empty input
steps: Open the task in the task management application.
Click the 'Edit' button for the task description.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message 'Description cannot be empty' and the description is not saved.

edge.title: Update the task description with maximum allowed length
steps: Open the task in the task management application.
Click the 'Edit' button for the task description.
Enter a description that is exactly the maximum allowed length.
edge.expected_result: The task description is updated successfully without errors, and the confirmation message 'Description updated successfully' is displayed.
